caveat:
Screen confirmed cleanup shots at older smalls while newer same-style work exists.

Distance and observed readiness are screens, not proof of an unobstructed ray.
Read-only native forecasts include queued damage already rolled by the server.
 Mage ready selections conservatively exclude temporary same-cycle claims; food/utility rejection may exclude extra alternatives. Planned-old-to-newer transitions are observed transitions, not an instrumented counter of guard activation.
